[[File:Predator.jpg|thumb|right|A predator on Tantajoc V]]
'''Tantajoc V predators''' were organisms native to [[Tantajoc V]] in the [[Tantajo system/Legends|Tantajo system]]. They were quite large and were known to attack those that invaded their territory. They were unique in that they they had an incredible healing mechanism which made them immune to the strikes of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], as their bodies would quickly repair the wound. The exiled [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Denid]] devised a way of destroying the creatures by employing an [[anti-magnetic polarization ray gun]]. A blast from a weapon would vaporize the creatures, counteracting their healing properties.
